name: World Championship
epitaph: RUSH's World Championship was first won by Cassius Deamont on 16 June 2002. The fed's own title log carries 3 reigns on it, across 3 different champions, and ends when the belt was vacated on 18 October 2002; the card of Decimation 2002 (22 December 2002), the pay-per-view RUSH and PCW staged together, crowns a fourth champion, Tyler Valentine, in the match for the vacant title. The longest reign with both dates on record is Cassius Deamont's, 63 days from 16 June 2002. One of its reigns ended outside a match — vacated. Valentine was still billed champion at Shanghaied III on 26 January 2003, and the surviving record carries no later change.

name: Syndicate Championship
epitaph: RUSH's Syndicate Championship was first won by Statuz Quo on 23 May 2002. The fed's own title log carries 2 reigns on it, across 2 different champions, and ends with El Spiffy!'s, from 18 August 2002; PCW's cards of December 2002 and January 2003 carry three more: Stimpo's (about 1 December 2002), Ebola III's (about 8 December 2002) and The Masked Mullet's, won from Ebola III at Shanghaied III on 26 January 2003. El Spiffy!'s is the longest, from 18 August to about 1 December 2002, which Decimation 2002's commentary counts as 107 days; Statuz Quo's, 87 days from 23 May 2002, is the longest with both dates exact. The Masked Mullet held it at the end of the surviving record.

name: Network Championship
epitaph: RUSH's Network Championship was first won by Marvin Harris on 2 May 2002. The fed's own title log carries 4 reigns on it, across 4 different champions, and ends with Livewire's, from 12 September 2002; PCW's cards of December 2002 and January 2003 carry a fifth, Matt Hunt's, won about 10 December 2002 and still held at Shanghaied III on 26 January 2003. Livewire's, of about three months, is the longest; Scott Cage's, 63 days from 16 June 2002, is the longest with both dates exact. Matt Hunt held it at the end of the surviving record.
